title: lithospermum lanceolatum
intro: Lithospermum lanceolatum, commonly known as Gromwell, is a perennial plant species in the borage family, known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Gromwell include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating various skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Gromwell include alkaloids, such as lithospermic acid and echinacoside, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
